title: 空弦 / Empty String — Original Demonstration
notice: 原创演示底轨 + SFX；未提供原片音源，电影主题变奏尚未制作。不声称官方配乐或可辨认的电影主题。
originalThemeStatus: Not produced: no film source supplied; no download, melody transcription or invented claim of film-theme recognition.
storyHashMeaning: This project has no separate story.mjs. storysha256 is explicitly an alias of the authoritative timeline.mjs SHA256.

bars.development: Exposed lyra question; overlapping natural decays, no bed
Last two solo notes and open-string overtones; no percussion
Low strings enter under skin drum 3+3+2; no chip lead
Viola suspension, darker bass and a wood-frame reply
Brief pulse shards and low orchestral stabs answer the dash
Fewer drums; mid-register response, not a repeated lead
Missing downbeat; skin/body impacts and descending inner strings
Offbeat frame taps, held tension and a breath before lift
Second short melody, higher lyra and low strings, rising action accents
Melody falls through Bb to A; airy upper strings, shorter drum tail
Turning stabs, sparse pulse, asymmetrical skin/wood replies
Single low accent, then sustained strings; percussion removed at 22.5s
Very quiet bowed-string tension; no drum, pulse or orchestral strike
Tension until beat 54; open-string plucks and sympathetic resonance
Far string harmonics, low-pitched spatial resonance, no melody loop
Unanswered open fifth; broad stereo decay with terminal fade

stages.label: 试弦
stages.notes: 里拉琴独奏，以真实计算的延迟弦与空弦泛音留出间隙；没有铺底与鼓。

stages.label: 迎击
stages.notes: 低弦进入，皮膜古战鼓以八分音符3+3+2重音，木框答句。

stages.label: 破势
stages.notes: 短pulse碎片与低铜管/弦乐冲击；没有连续芯片主题循环。

stages.label: 闪避
stages.notes: 抽掉强拍，低弦下行、木框错位与衣物/土层声音分开。

stages.label: 腾空
stages.notes: 第二次短旋律提高音区，泛音与弦乐呼应腾空；不是第一段换音量。

stages.label: 回身
stages.notes: 回身用短合奏回应，末小节减法撤鼓，所有鼓和鼓混响止于22.5秒。

stages.label: 空弦
stages.notes: 22.5至25.3125秒极轻弦张力；放弦后由空弦与低脉冲接住，不用激光扫频。

stages.label: 余响
stages.notes: 相隔的弦模态泛音、宽立体声尾音；不再恢复鼓阵与旋律循环。

events.material: modeled bow string / bridge / sympathetic open strings / low pulse
far sympathetic string harmonics, no metal bell or laser

sfx.timingScope: Dry and isolated causal source onsets measured sample-by-sample. MP3 matched-waveform lag separately measured against gapless lossless reference; pre-echo is not asserted to be zero.
sfx.balanceScope: Static per-event gain against concurrent music; decoded aggregate SFX/music also checked in sliding 60ms windows (30ms steps) over first 600ms.

processing.measurement: EBU R128 measurement only; no loudnorm
processing.stemPolicy: Same fixed gain and actual shared master-limiter gain envelope, never independent loudness normalization
processing.signalChain: Computed 48kHz float stereo -> causal HP24/LP11500 -> 4x resampling -> fixed gain -> stereo-linked alimiter -> common limiter gain to both stems -> 48kHz -> shared fade -> gapless MP3

delivery.replacement: Main player may replace demo with authorized local user music and retain sfx. This audio-only task does not modify the player.
delivery.gapless: Container duration includes MPEG frame padding. Decoded PCM must be exactly 1,440,000 frames, 30 seconds for every track.
delivery.references: proof/*.wav are 48kHz float lossless QA references, not external inputs.

provenance.synthesis: Computed fractional-delay plucked strings, sympathetic additive modes, detuned bowed strings/brass, short anti-aliased pulse, skin/wood/metal/cloth/earth DSP.
provenance.engineering: Basic oscillator, fractional-delay and fixed-gain engineering informed by read-only odyssey/score.mjs. No old module imported or executed; all musical notes and form newly authored.

checks: 14 exact event IDs and sample clock
deterministic re-synthesis source and generator/timeline SHA256
3 MP3 + 3 reference full decodes / exactly 1440000 stereo frames
R128 and true peak measured on every actual file
all percussion and percussion room zero after22.5s
lossless stem sum relative RMS <-100dB; lossy sum <-24dB
validation.scope: Signal/provenance measurements, not a listening review or a claim that a film theme was reproduced.
